in_marathi.name: Yug
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Age, Epoch, Cycle
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yug हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yug is a Sanskrit term that refers to an age or a cycle in Hindu mythology. It is often used to describe the four major ages or cycles in Hinduism, namely the Satya Yug, Treta Yug, Dwapar Yug, and Kali Yug. Each yug is characterized by its moral and ethical values, and the current age, Kali Yug, is believed to be a time of darkness and moral decay, preceding the next age of light and enlightenment.
